children.value: uktaṃ svapnasāmyaṃ jagataḥ prapañcayituṃ pīṭhikāṃ racayati - svabhāvamiti

idaṃ jāgrajjagattvena nojjhitameva sat suṣuptamajñānameva mūlataḥ
śilājaṭharamevādhiṣṭhānataḥ śūnyaṃ khameva svata ityarthaḥ
svapno'pyetādṛśa eveti sa evātra dṛṣṭānta ityāha - svapna iti

svayameva bhavati astīti svayaṃbhuvā
cidvyomnā tamovṛtātmarūpe vyomani adryādirūpabhṛtsvacamatkārastama eva
jāgratsvapne jagadityantarbuddhaḥ

bhāsyajagataḥ śūnyatve
citastadbhāsakaṃ rūpaṃ ca na kiṃcana

nabhaḥ atyantāsatī ete cijjagatī grāhyagrāhakarūpe
brahmaṇi mudhā bhātaḥ

evaṃ jāgratyapi ābhātaṃ trailokyamevaṃ
nirvapuḥ śūnyameva
avyoma brahmaiva ativitataṃ śūnyātmakaṃ vyoma prathamaṃ saṃpannam

athavā avyoma girimahīpurādi vyoma
bhavati evaṃ vyomaivācalasaṃghātādi bhavatīti yathāśrutaṃ pratijñāparam

abdāśca abdhayaśca adrayaśca teṣāṃ
nirghoṣaśca svapne ekaṃ suptaṃ prati prasiddho'pyaparaṃ prati maunaṃ śūnyameva yathā
tathā jāgradabdādayo'pītyarthaḥ

yataḥ pārśvasthaḥ aparaḥ suptanaraḥ saṃprabudhyāpi kiṃcana
abdābdhyādi tadghoṣaṃ vā na śṛṇotyeva

ajāto'pi vandhyāyāstanayaḥ svapne
prajāyate tathātrāpi bodhyamityarthaḥ

evaṃ mṛtvā jāto'pi puruṣa ātmanaḥ svasya
mṛtervismṛtau satyāmajāto'nutpanna evāhamityāste yathā tathetyarthaḥ
suptasya svapne svaśayanabhuvo'nanubhavo yathā tadasattvamāpādayati tathetyarthaḥ
yadyasmāddhetoḥ svapnaheturvāsaro yasyāṃ tathāvidhā ulūkādīnāṃ nidrā dṛśyate

varṇitaṃ jāgratsvapnayoḥ sāmyamākṣipya vaiṣamyaṃ darśayan rāmaḥ śaṅkate -
naitaditi

yatra yasminsvapne
kṣiprājjāyamāno bādhako yo jāgratpratyayastaddarśanenāntaḥ svayameva
tasyābhāsatānubhavāt

svapnadeśe hi sanidraḥ svapnadehastho draṣṭā
svāpnabandhvādīnpaśyati

na ca deśāntare dehāntaradṛṣṭānāṃn
dehāntare deśāntare cānyadarśane tadadarśanaṃ tadbādhaḥ

pūrvajanmabandhvādīnāmiha janmanyadarśanasyāpi tadbādhatvāpatteriti
sāmyānapāyādityāśayena vasiṣṭhaḥ samādhatte - vihṛtyetyādisaptabhiḥ

sa ca
pratyayo na svāpnārthabādhanasamartha iti dyotanāya saṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅ

pūrvasmin jāgradātmani prapañcena
svapnamasadityevaṃ punaḥ pratyayaṃn yathā ādatte tathā svapnātsvapnāntaraṃ gata
uttarasvapne jāgratpratyayaṃ punargṛhṇāti

tata uttarasvapne jāgratpratyayo yathā
mugdhatāprayuktastadvatpūrvajāgrati svapnatvāsattvayoragrahaṇamapi
mugdhatāprayuktameveti bhāvaḥ

atha tatrāpi svapne svapnasaṃdarśanānantaramanubhavatsvapnameva jāgrattayā
anubhavatīti pūrveṇānvayaḥ

evaṃrītyā jāgratsvapnatvaṃ cetyevaṃ nāmani
avasthādvaye'yaṃ jīvaḥ svato na jāyate na mriyate

tathā ca svapnadraṣṭā svapne mṛtaḥ san iha jāgare prabuddhaḥ kathyate iha jāgrati
mṛtastu anyatra svapne prabuddhaḥ kathyata iti tayoḥ sāmyamevetyarthaḥ

evaṃ ca svapnātsvapnāntarasthitau dvitīyaṃ svapnarūpameva pūrvāpekṣayā
vartamānatvātprakṛṣṭaṃ darśanaṃ jāgradbhavati

evaṃ jāgrati mṛtvā anyatra svapne
jāgradantare vā prabuddhasya puṃsaḥ pūrvajāgratsvapna evālamavaśyaṃ bhavati

itihāsaḥ kīrtyamānapūrvavṛttakathārthastanmayau tatsadṛśāveva na yathārthāviti
hetoḥ parasparamupamānopameyatāṃ gatāvityarthaḥ

itīhāsamayau iti dīrghapāṭhe tu iti
iha asamaṃ viṣamaṃ yāta ityasamayau kiṃcidvilakṣaṇāvapītyarthaḥ
kiṃ ca vartamānadaśāyāṃ svapno'pi jāgradiva pratyakṣamābhāti

atītaṃ tu jāgradapi
prasiddha svapnamiva uditam

he prājña asminnarthe vidvadbhiḥ saha yuktyā
saṃvada saṃvādenāvadhāraya

vicārotpannatattvadaśane sā prasiddhā cideva svāpnopala
iti pareṇānvayaḥ

svapne prasiddhaṃ purācalādi yathā
saṃvinmayaṃ gaganameva he subhaga jāgrati prasiddhaṃ purācalādyapi tadvadeva
saṃvinmayaṃ gaganameva

evaṃ ca svapno'tha jāgraditi vikalpanaśāntamekaṃ
cinmātrameva pariśiṣṭam

atra īdṛśe tattve vādināṃ viṣayaṃ vinā vṛthā vivāda
ityarthaḥ
